name: Operational source authority
rule: Analytics never silently overwrites authoritative operational records; corrections flow through governed source or analytical correction policy.

name: Tenant isolation
rule: Warehouse/lakehouse/query/report/export/feature data remains tenant isolated according to Phase 28 policy.

name: Certified metrics
rule: Executive/official reports use certified metric definitions and versions.

name: Metric grain
rule: Every metric defines grain, numerator/denominator or expression, filters, time basis, units and owner.

name: Historical reproducibility
rule: Historical reports can resolve the metric/model/transformation versions and source snapshot/time used.

name: Lineage
rule: Certified datasets/metrics/reports preserve source-to-output lineage.

name: Freshness disclosure
rule: Reports/dashboards expose or can retrieve data freshness/status when material.

name: Quality gate
rule: Failed blocking data-quality/reconciliation checks prevent certification/publication of affected outputs.

name: Late arriving data
rule: Late-arriving facts/dimensions are handled through governed correction/backfill logic, preserving history.

name: Schema evolution
rule: Breaking schema changes require versioning/migration and downstream impact review.

name: SCD history
rule: Configured master/reference dimensions preserve historical attributes using governed slowly changing dimension policy.

name: Row/column security
rule: Semantic/report queries enforce tenant, role, project, classification and field-level policy.

name: Export control
rule: Analytical exports apply permission, classification, audit and size/rate policy.

name: Report versioning
rule: Published reports/dashboards are versioned; material definition changes create new versions.

name: Self-service boundary
rule: Self-service users may compose queries only from permitted/certified semantic fields unless granted advanced access.

name: Reconciliation
rule: Financial/commercial/estimate/job-cost control totals reconcile to authoritative sources under defined tolerances.

name: Benchmark anonymity
rule: Shared benchmark populations must follow tenant/privacy policy and cannot expose another tenant’s identifiable data.

name: Forecast labeling
rule: Forecasts/scenarios are labeled as model outputs with assumptions/version and are not presented as actuals.

name: Feature point-in-time correctness
rule: AI-ready feature snapshots prevent future-data leakage for historical training/evaluation use.

name: Embedding permissions
rule: Embedding/vector metadata retains source tenant, source record/version and access policy references.

name: No unauthorized AI bypass
rule: AI analytics access uses the same certified/permissioned semantic and source controls as human analytics.

name: Pipeline idempotency
rule: Retry/backfill pipelines avoid duplicate analytical facts according to configured business keys/checkpoints.

name: Data incident trace
rule: Corrections/backfills retain incident, impacted outputs, prior state and revalidation evidence.

name: Cost/performance governance
rule: Warehouse/lakehouse/query resource use is monitored and optimized without changing certified semantics.

name: Deletion propagation
rule: Approved privacy/deletion requirements propagate to analytical copies according to retention/legal policy.

name: Audit
rule: Dataset/model/metric/report publication, privileged queries and exports create audit evidence.

name: Time-zone/calendar consistency
rule: Metric/report time calculations use explicit timezone/fiscal/calendar definitions.

name: Currency/unit semantics
rule: Cross-region/currency/unit analytics use governed conversions and preserve original values where required.

name: AI evaluation data
rule: AI evaluation/training feature datasets retain approved source, version, inclusion/exclusion and privacy metadata.

name: Certified versus draft
rule: Draft/unverified datasets and metrics are visibly distinguished from certified assets.
